title: Healthy Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: A nutritious and delicious breakfast packed with vitamins and fiber
instructions: Peel and slice the frozen bananas into chunks
Add bananas, almond milk, and honey to a blender
Blend until smooth and creamy (about 2-3 minutes)
Pour into bowls
Top with chia seeds and fresh berries
Serve immediately for best texture
tips: Use very ripe bananas for maximum sweetness
Adjust almond milk for desired consistency
Try coconut flakes or nuts as additional toppings
healthBenefits: High in potassium for heart health
Omega-3 fatty acids from chia seeds

title: Grilled Chicken with Quinoa Salad
description: A complete protein meal with ancient grains and fresh vegetables
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until water runs clear
Cook quinoa in 2 cups water for 15 minutes, then let stand 5 minutes
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and 1 tbsp olive oil
Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice
Dice bell peppers, cucumber, and halve cherry tomatoes
Fluff quinoa with a fork and mix with vegetables
Whisk remaining olive oil with lemon juice for dressing
Toss quinoa salad with dressing
Serve sliced chicken over quinoa salad
mealPrepNotes: Can be stored in refrigerator for up to 4 days
Chicken can be grilled ahead and reheated
variations: Substitute quinoa with brown rice or bulgur
Add feta cheese for extra protein and flavor
Use balsamic vinaigrette instead of lemon dressing

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty plant-based meal rich in protein and Mediterranean flavors
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat
Sauté onion until translucent (about 5 minutes)
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute
Add diced tomatoes, chickpeas, and vegetable broth
Season with salt, pepper, oregano, and bay leaves
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
Add fresh spinach and cook until wilted (2-3 minutes)
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed
Remove bay leaves before serving
Serve hot with crusty bread or over rice
healthBenefits: High in plant-based protein from chickpeas
Heart-healthy monounsaturated fats from olive oil
High fiber content supports digestive health
storage: Reheat gently on stovetop or microwave
